headline: Drone hits busy Russian beach, killing seven including children
summary: A drone crashed on a Black Sea beach near Arkhipo-Osipovka, killing seven including three children and injuring 40, local officials say.
script: A drone has hit a busy beach in southern Russia, killing seven people including three children. Local authorities say forty were injured, and both sides deny deliberately targeting civilians.
imageAlt: Emergency services at a Black Sea beach after a drone strike.
imageAltTwo: Tourists on the beach at Arkhipo-Osipovka on the Black Sea.
